Name: Create your own Interface Recolour
Author: leodolons
Description:
All you need to do is edit the texture png's with any editing software you have, and this mod will apply them to the game, so you dont need to write the .json files. This provides simplified texture pngs that only have the interface related textures for easy editing.

[size=5]FOR LESS TECH SAVVY FOLKS:[/size]
If you go inside the "assets" folder in the mod, you will see a bunch of pictures, you just need to edit/change them using something like gimp/procreate/adobe etc
If you havent used an app to edit a picture before or are unfamiliar with the above apps, try using this website https://www.pixilart.com/ . All you need to do is press the start drawing button, then either click on file, then either import or open photo, then you can draw and colour them, then you press file again and choose export/download, then press download png. After that you just need to replace the picture thats in the "assets" folder, make sure that you name this new picture the same name as the old picture.

USE THIS MOD TO GET RID OF FONT SHADOWS:
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12467

TO EDIT THE SKY COLOURS:
To change the sky there is a really tiny 2 pixel wide line next to the fishrod on cursors.png, the right hand line is the colour gradient for the sky, so edit that.
The mountains are also on the cursor.png, and clouds.png are the clouds on the main menu.

 
Feel free to post your recolours using this preset mod, just link back to this mod in the description :)
